business_scope.primary_industry_name: Dedicated Offshore Software Engineering and Maintenance Hub

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (unitary national jurisdiction, no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English common law statutory foundation with Samoan customary law (Fa'asamoa and Fa'amatai customary land/title structures); Constitution of the Independent State of Samoa 1960
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: WTO Membership since 6 January 2012 (GATS, TRIPS, MFN disciplines)
PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus), in force for Samoa
Treaty of Friendship between Samoa and New Zealand (1962)
Samoa and ACP-EU Cooperation Agreements (Cotonou Agreement and successor Economic Partnership Arrangements)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Governing instruments: (1) Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2018 (AML/CFT Act 2018), as amended, supervised and enforced by the Central Bank of Samoa, mandating customer due diligence, beneficial-owner identification at the 25% control threshold, record-keeping, and suspicious-transaction reporting to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU); (2) International Companies Act 1987, as amended by the 2008, 2018 and 2020 amending Acts, and the International Companies Regulations 2008 — statutory registers of directors, members, and beneficial ownership must be held at the Samoan registered office by a licensed registered agent; (3) Financial Institutions Act 1996 and the Central Bank of Samoa AML/CFT Consolidated Guidelines; (4) FATF — Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation standards applicable to Samoa; (5) OECD Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes commitments, including exchange of beneficial ownership information upon request.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport identity page of each natural-person shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly licensed notary public of the origin jurisdiction, with notarial seal and signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the origin jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention contracting state (e.g., Hong Kong SAR, New Zealand, Australia, United Kingdom); otherwise full-chain Samoan consular legalization via the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of proof of residential address (utility statement or bank statement issued within the preceding 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility issuer or principal bank, jointly certified true by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Apostille contracting states) OR consular legalization (non-contracting states including mainland PRC)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incumbency, register of directors, and copy of constitutional documents of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent-company registry or registered agent (e.g., Hong Kong Companies Registry, ACRA, or other competent corporate registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for registry certificates originating in Apostille states; consular legalization route for documents originating in non-Hague states such as mainland China

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (good standing) covering the beneficial owner and proposed signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank maintaining the UBO's principal banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized banker's signature followed by apostille or consular legalization as applicable to the issuing state

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, signatories, and ultimate counterparties against (1) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, (2) OFAC SDN List, (3) EU and UK HMT consolidated financial sanctions targets, and (4) domestic Samoa Central Bank/FIU advisories and public notices. PEP identification is mandatory: any foreign or domestic PEP, close associate, or family member triggers enhanced due diligence (EDD) requiring source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, senior-management approval, and heightened ongoing monitoring. Negative-news and adverse-media screening is run for every onboarding. The ISIC 6202 offshore software engineering and maintenance hub is assessed as Low_Risk_Standard, requiring standard CDD plus periodic two-yearly CDD refresh and continuous transaction monitoring for the Wise_B2B, Payoneer, and Wire payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry — MCIL (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour), Apia; corporate name availability search and reservation module of the Registrar of International Companies; in-person lodgment also accepted at the Registrar's counter
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in English or Samoan, using Roman script characters only; non-Roman scripts (CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic, etc.) are not permitted in the registered name and will not be transliterated on the Certificate of Incorporation. The name must be distinctive, not misleading as to activity, nationality, or government connection, and must not create a trademark or passing-off conflict with existing registered companies. An International Company must end with 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd'; abridged or short-title commercial variants must be registered with a clear English transliteration for use in banking, contracting, and outsourcing agreements.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Samoa (or any derivative implying official Samoan Government endorsement)
Bank / Banking / Banc (requires a Central Bank of Samoa license)
Trust / Trustee (requires trust license or ministerial consent)
University / College / Institute (educational competence consent required)
Offshore / Global / International (may be refused if the name is misleading without a genuine licensed international company designation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the Registrar of International Companies issues a written refusal specifying the statutory grounds. The applicant may file a written reconsideration request within 14 calendar days of the refusal, attaching revised name alternatives and supporting legal arguments. The Registrar is obliged to issue a formal decision within 21 business days. A further appeal lies to the Samoa Supreme Court pursuant to the judicial review jurisdiction applicable under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Constitution of the Independent State of Samoa 1960. Where the name is conditionally reserved subject to ministerial consent, the appeal may instead be remitted to the relevant licensing ministry (e.g., Central Bank, Ministry of Finance, or Ministry of Education).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Registry-level virtual office is permissible: the compulsory Samoa registered office may be satisfied by the licensed registered agent's physical address in Apia. For the ISIC 6202 Dedicated Offshore Software Engineering and Maintenance Hub, however, a substantive operational location with actual staff and project-management capability (the ODC delivery site) is required to satisfy economic-substance expectations and to justify the tax-exempt offshore characterization; a purely passive virtual presence materially elevates permanent-establishment, substance-challenge, and bank-onboarding risk and is not recommended for the target payment rails (Wise_B2B, Payoneer, Wire).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for this segment: estimated below 5% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the Registrar or Central Bank of Samoa in the first year for a low-risk standard-tier software-services international company. Nevertheless, the licensed registered agent's office is itself subject to periodic AML/CFT inspection, and the ODC must be able to evidence commercial substance, payroll, and operational records on 48-hours' notice.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies Amendment Act 2012, ss. 5–15, 31, 42 and 78
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with Form IIC-1 Application for Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; share capital may be denominated in any currency; no escrow account required under Samoan law
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the Company be and is hereby incorporated as an International Company under the International Companies Act 1987. FURTHER RESOLVED that the founding shareholder's subscription for ordinary shares, as recorded in the register of members, be and is hereby accepted and such shares be allotted fully paid. RESOLVED THAT the registered office and registered agent in Samoa designated in the consent on file be and are hereby adopted. RESOLVED THAT the Directors named in the incorporation statement take office. RESOLVED THAT the Managing Director and Company Secretary be and are hereby appointed with authority to execute banking documents, contracts, and filings. RESOLVED THAT the Articles of Association as approved be filed with the Registrar and become effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Companies Registry, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request via the SIFA e-registry portal or physical counter. The name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered company. A reserved name is valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Notarized copy of passport of subscribing shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file a fresh reservation with revised wording; the Registrar may allow informal reconsideration within 5 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association and Registered Agent Consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA – Companies Registry, Apia (pre-filing review by a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Samoan licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, including indemnity provisions, share classes, and quorum rules. The registered agent must sign the consent to act as the company's registered agent, confirming the registered office address in Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If draft documents are queried, amend the relevant clauses and resubmit through the registered agent; no additional government fee is charged for the first correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the Incorporation Application and Pay Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA – Registrar of International Companies, Apia (via online portal or physical submission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IIC-1 together with the approved Memorandum and Articles, registered agent consent, and prescribed government fee. Payment is accepted by bank transfer, card, or direct deposit to the SIFA consolidation account. Retain the payment receipt as proof of filing.
required_dossiers: Final Memorandum and Articles of Association
Identity proof of shareholders and directors (notarized)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where an application is queried for deficient particulars, the applicant may file a corrective filing within 10 business days using the same reference number; late correction may attract an enforcement fee of USD 50.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Aliens, Stamp Duty and Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA – Registrar of International Companies and Ministry of Revenue (stamping section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After substantive review, the Memorandum and Articles are stamped by the Ministry of Revenue. The Registrar then certifies incorporation and issues the Certificate of Incorporation along with a certified copy of the registered documents.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issuance request (internal desk transfer)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is delayed, the applicant may escalate to the Registrar's central office via written request; the Registrar must issue the certificate within 14 days of all filings being in order, failing which a fee refund may be claimed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Formalities and Bank / Payment Rail Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company itself, assisted by a licensed registered agent and the Ministry of Commercial Affairs for records verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following issuance of the Certificate, the directors must adopt a minute book and share register, file beneficial ownership particulars (if required), and open a corporate bank account with an international bank in Samoa or overseas. For the target payment rails (Wise B2B, Payoneer, Wire), the director must submit the certified Certificate, Articles and officers' list to the respective financial institution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a foreign bank rejects the company's due diligence package, the registered agent may assist in preparing a legal opinion confirming the company's good standing; the company may then reapply to a different payment rail.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None – the International Company is not subject to industrial manufacturing licensing for offshore software engineering and maintenance services
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required – offshore services are exempt from Samoan industrial licensing; no separate operating permit is issued for a software development center

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not required / Exempt – the activity is office-based and does not trigger a Full EIA Report or Registration under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for IT services; if the office leases space, the occupier must comply with municipal solid waste disposal rules and the health & safety standards for low-voltage ICT equipment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For office premises in Samoa, a fire clearance certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) is required; structural load validation is required only if the premises are physically burdened by server racks and heavy equipment. A general workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002 is recommended but not a prerequisite for IT-only offshore centers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of the Independent State of Samoa (MfR); official e-portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must file the prescribed TIN/GST registration application with MfR, submitting apostilled certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, certificate of good standing from the home registry, registered agent confirmation, Samoan office address and service of process details, ultimate beneficial ownership declaration, and notarized passport copies of all directors. MfR issues a Samoa Tax Identification Number (TIN) and, where a taxable activity in Samoa exists, a separate GST registration number. An International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 is, unless it has a Samoan taxable supply nexus, outside the income tax registration net and receives only an International Company certificate file number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists in Samoa. An International Company obtains its tax-exempt status by valid incorporation and licensing under the International Companies Act 1987. It may voluntarily elect to register for GST if it makes taxable supplies with a Samoan nexus, but it cannot elect into Samoan income tax or alter its statutory offshore tax exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Goods and Services Tax (GST) under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2006
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of taxable supplies in any consecutive twelve-month period
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not impose real-time fiscal clearance, API-based pre-approval, or digital stamping of invoices. GST-registered suppliers must issue prescribed tax invoices showing the TIN, GST amount, supplier and recipient details, and date of supply. Electronic invoices may be filed through the MfR e-services portal, are subject to post-filing audit, and must be retained for at least seven years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies to tangible goods exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply, where the supplier retains verified proof of export, and to services supplied to a non-resident for use or consumption entirely outside Samoa where the recipient is not engaged in a Samoan taxable activity. Offshore software development and maintenance services supplied by an International Company to a foreign client, invoiced in foreign currency, and performed outside Samoa satisfy this criterion.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed through Samoan Customs systems
Bill of Lading, airway bill, or equivalent transport document evidencing physical departure
Inward Remittance Certificate from a licensed Samoan bank proving foreign exchange receipt
Commercial invoice and packing list issued by the exporting entity
Offshore service agreement and delivery or acceptance milestone records
Certificate of origin or export permit where required by the destination market
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: MfR may retrospectively reassess any refunded GST within four years of the relevant tax period where zero-rating substantiation is defective. A false or misleading export claim attracts a tax shortfall penalty of up to 50% of the GST overclaimed, monthly late payment penalties, and interest. Intentional tax evasion is a criminal offence punishable by a fine not exceeding WST 100,000 and/or imprisonment not exceeding seven years, with full clawback of the refunded amount plus penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), acting as the Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act 1975, the Exchange Control Regulations 1976, and the Financial Institutions Act 1996; the CBS designates authorized foreign-exchange dealers (commercial banks) and grants exchange-control permissions for capital and current account transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoa tala operates under a managed-float regime with partial convertibility: current-account payments (trade invoices, software and IT services fees, insurance, interest, and normal operational remittances) are generally permitted through an authorized dealer upon production of genuine contract and invoice evidence; capital-account transactions (equity subscriptions, loan capital, liquidation distributions, and profit repatriation by non-resident International Companies) require CBS-specific exchange-control approval, but for a qualifying International Company such approvals are available on a non-prejudicial basis. Profit and dividend remittances are not subject to Samoan income or withholding tax for a tax-exempt IC, provided the paying bank receives a Certificate of Exemption/registered agent confirmation and the underlying revenue arises from qualifying offshore activities rather than domestic Samoan-source transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The statutory default requires all export and service receipts to be collected through a licensed authorized dealer in Samoa and repatriated no later than 90 days from shipment/invoice date. The mandatory conversion standard is 100% of the gross foreign-currency proceeds converted to Samoa tala unless the CBS grants a specific exemption. For an Offshore Development Center structured as an International Company, digital/software services may be treated as invisible current-account receipts, and a standing exemption may be requested in writing to retain USD/WST bank balances for working-capital purposes rather than forced conversion on every receipt.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and multi-currency Operational Account (WST/USD)
Operational Account / USD settlement and trade account
Capital Escrow Account / multi-currency operating account; global correspondent network

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BSP Samoa Limited (Bank of South Pacific)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / trade settlement and SWIFT account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: The viability rating is Medium for ancillary settlement and Low as a primary banking rail. Fintech electronic money institutions (e.g. Wise B2B, Payoneer) are not licensed by the Central Bank of Samoa, hold no Samoan banking licence, and cannot provide WST-denominated accounts or CBS-supervised liquidity. They may lawfully be used as collection corridors for global software development fees, but all funds must ultimately be moved through a licensed authorized dealer for Samoan statutory/tax payments, payroll, or capital repatriation. Additional legal constraints include a required board resolution designating the EMI, custody limitations applicable to client funds held overseas, and enhanced CRS/FATCA classification risk unless the IC obtains and provides a Samoa Tax Identification Number and exemption certificate.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The International Companies Act does not impose a statutory requirement for directors to appear physically in Samoa for incorporation or banking. In practice, tier-1 Samoan banks' AML/CFT policies require at least one authorised director or ultimate beneficial owner to attend an in-person interview, usually at the bank's Apia branch, or to accept a hybrid remote/video KYC process where the registered agent in Samoa witnesses the signature and a sealed board resolution is submitted. Fully remote account opening is possible for low-risk offshore software entities under enhanced video identity verification, but banks commonly retain discretion to refuse optional remote channels for higher-risk ownership structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of ultimate beneficial ownership through nominee shareholders, family trusts, or multi-layered offshore holding chains.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current UBO register, trust deed/declaration of trust extract, registered-agent CDD file, source-of-wealth statement for each 10%-or-more beneficial owner, signed consent to information sharing with the Samoan bank, and professional references from the upstream corporate-services provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face director signatures and remotely executed account-opening documents.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Consularised or apostilled board resolutions, certified passport copies with liveness verification, independent director background checks, bank/reference letters from director's home institution, and a signed verification certificate by a Samoa-licensed registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commercial substance mismatch: software-development invoices issued from Samoa to related offshore companies while actual developer headcount and management appear domiciled elsewhere.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master services agreements, itemised technical statements, payroll records of Samoan-resident engineers, office lease/registered address evidence, management meeting minutes, reasonable intercompany transfer-pricing documentation, and evidence that day-to-day decisions occur in Samoa.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming capital injections from private cryptocurrency exchanges, unregulated money transmitters, or jurisdictions with weak AML enforcement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Refused-tainted-source policy; downstream ordering-bank statements; crypto-to-fiat trail and transaction hash records; proof of share subscription; CBS exchange-control application (where equity/loan capital); and a board resolution approving the remitting route.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Persons (PEP), prominent public officials, or unexplained family wealth among ultra-high-net-worth convenantors and shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent PEP/sanctions screening reports, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations, forensic financial statements, client/originating corporate business rationale, compliance-committee enhanced due diligence, and continuous transaction monitoring undertakings.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder-loan capital must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 using the shareholder's own bank account in the shareholder's jurisdiction. The instructed beneficiary is the International Company's capital-escrow account at a CBS-licensed authorized dealer. Field 70/Remittance Information should carry purpose code 'EQUITY-INJECTION-IC' (or the dealer's required exchange-control purpose description) plus the share allotment reference. The bank will seek CBS approval on an application form for capital account transfers; concurrently the IC must submit a board allotment resolution, amended register of members, source-of-funds evidence (balance sheet/tax returns/bank statements), and a registered-agent certificate confirming solvency and legal existence. Wire splitting below reporting thresholds is expressly prohibited; funds should be received in full, recorded in the capital account, and swept to the operational account only after CBS confirmation and bank compliance release.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational outflows are cleared using (i) SWIFT MT103 for direct transfer of software subcontract fees, vendor licences, consultancy invoices, and contractor salaries where the beneficiary has a bank account; (ii) SWIFT MT700 commercial letter of credit issued by the Samoan authorized dealer for physical equipment/hardware acquisitions, usually sight or 60-day usance, with supporting purchase order and transport documents; and (iii) SWIFT MT202 for interbank correspondent funding where a separate cover payment is required. All outbound remittance instructions must include the underlying contract/invoice reference in field 70, be accompanied by an approved purchase invoice or service certificate, and pass CBS current-account/anti-money-laundering screening. Ongoing digitised vendor payments may be batched through Wise B2B/Payoneer only for non-capital, low-value operating expenses and must never exceed the exchange-control documentary threshold without dealer confirmation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Samoa Tala/USD forward contracts with a licensed authorized dealer, for maturities up to 12 months, backed by a written underlying trade or service exposure.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/WST available from global banks, economically hedging conversion risk without requiring Samoan settlement if the IC books in USD or an offshore vehicle.
Cross-currency swaps (CCS/CCIRS) under an ISDA master agreement or Samoan bank treasury line, converting USD floating/floating flows to WST fixed/floating flows with CBS notification.
FX swaps combining an immediate spot transaction with an agreed forward reversal, used for short-term liquidity bridging between the capital account and operational account.
Option collars and participating forwards with a licensed dealer, documented as hedge-only instruments directly linked to forecast sale cycles of the offshore development center.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual return and renewal declaration (Form ARI-1) confirming registered details, shareholders, directors, and registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (Samoa)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; a filing grace period of 60 days is available for an additional late fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Customary late penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month or part of a month; continued non-payment for 90 days after the due date becomes a ground for administrative strike-off and forfeiture of assets to the Crown.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic substance notification and annual compliance declaration (Nil activity / non-qualifying entity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months of each financial year-end; financial year may end on 31 December unless the board elects otherwise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may trigger a fine up to USD 2,000 and a default determination that the company carries on a relevant activity, exposing it to additional recordkeeping and reporting obligations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None — international companies are exempt from statutory audit irrespective of turnover, balance-sheet total, or number of employees; a certified audit may be voluntarily required by shareholders, banks, or a court order.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (or US GAAP if adopted by the board); financial statements are not required to be filed with the Registrar, but books and records must be available for inspection in Samoa or at the registered agent's office.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and retain current beneficial-ownership information. An annual confirmation statement must be signed by the director and filed with the Registrar of International Companies on the anniversary date. Any share transfer or change in directors/UBOs occurring during the year must be lodged with the Registrar within 21 days of the event using the prescribed change notice.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$750 – US$1,200 depending on the licensed agent, plus US$150 for nominee services if elected
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary certified audit typically US$2,500 – US$7,500 for an offshore development center

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% statutory rate for International Companies (International Companies Act 1987, s.198); domestic headline corporate income tax rate for non-exempt companies is 27%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full exemption from income tax, withholding, capital gains, estate and gift duty, and stamp duty on all profits, distributions, and transactions of the IC for a guaranteed 20-year period from incorporation; no minimum capital requirement; no exchange control restrictions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for an exempt International Company. The only annual statutory compliance is the IC Annual Return and Government Fee lodged with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), filed through the MCIL electronic registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On the anniversary of incorporation each year; a late fee regime applies after the due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the certificate of incorporation exactly; no translation or trading name may be substituted.
Insert the unique IC number as issued by the Registrar at incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent and registered office in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Samoan-licensed financial services provider must sign and confirm the agent-client relationship; a post office box in Apia may serve as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital and annual fee band.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital is required; the annual government fee is calculated from the authorized capital using the IC Act fee schedule.
Declare that no business is conducted with Samoan residents and that the company did not derive income subject to the Income Tax Ordinance 1974; no accounts are attached.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return and fee subjects the IC to a monetary surcharge; persistent default generally results in strike-off from the International Companies Register, forfeiture of assets to the Registrar, and director disqualification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Domestic benchmark only: Samoa Company Income Tax Return, filed through the Ministry for Revenue tax return portal. Non-exempt domestic companies file a self-assessment return, but an International Company is outside the scope of the income tax filing obligation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Domestic companies must file within 90 days of the accounting period end; irrelevant to exempt ICs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Leave nil and attach the IC exemption certificate reference if the Commissioner queries.
State the statutory exemption provision; do not claim deductions for ODC development costs in this filing because no taxable income arises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: For domestic companies, late filing attracts 5% of the assessed tax per month up to a 50% cap, plus late payment interest at 20% per annum; for exempt ICs, no failure can arise as no return is due.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for International Companies and their non-resident shareholders (International Companies Act 1987, s.198; the distribution is exempt from all Samoan taxes). The domestic non-exempt withholding tax rate on dividends is 15%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Although IC distributions carry a 0% domestic rate, treaty protection is invoked by obtaining a Tax Residency Certificate from the Ministry for Revenue: the corporate officer submits Form TRC-01, the certificate of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, a beneficial ownership declaration, and the prescribed fee; processing takes 5-10 business days. DTAs with Australia and New Zealand provide 5%/15% dividend, 10% interest, and 10% royalty limits, but the IC exemption already renders Samoan-source repatriation tax-free, so the TRC is most relevant to evidence effective management and to avoid foreign withholding tax on inbound development fees.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory WHT: 15% on interest and 15% on royalties paid to non-residents. Australia treaty: interest 10%, royalties 10%. New Zealand treaty: interest 10%, royalties 10%. For the exempt IC, Samoan-source royalties and interest are likewise exempt, shifting the compliance burden to the payor jurisdiction's CFC and royalty anti-abuse rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not Applicable - Samoa has not enacted Local File, Master File, or CbCR documentation thresholds in law. The Commissioner of Inland Revenue may nonetheless adjust non-arm's length arrangements under general anti-avoidance provisions (Income Tax Ordinance 1974, s.99). Prudent ODC practice: maintain contemporaneous cost-plus or TNMM benchmarks for intercompany service fees even though no Samoan statutory threshold is triggered.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa has no Economic Substance Regulations filing of the BVI or UAE style. Substance requirements are indirect: the IC must be administered by a licensed registered agent, maintain a registered office, keep accounting records and a beneficial ownership register (Beneficial Ownership Act 2020), and must not carry on business with Samoan residents. An ODC structure purely booking offshore income with no people or offices invites CFC attribution in the shareholder's home country.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Samoan IC to invoice global software development services while the ODC team, contracts, and management are entirely in another jurisdiction and no books, records, or beneficial ownership register are kept in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off under the International Companies Act 1987; assets are forfeited to the Registrar; the IC loses the s.198 tax exemption retroactively for the period of abuse.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally assessed for the re-imposed corporate income tax and penalties; the courts may impose a travel ban, restitution order for the diverted amounts, and criminal fines of up to USD 20,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately suppressing ODC service revenue received through Wise B2B, Payoneer, or wire rails, or asserting the IC exemption for services that were contractually performed and delivered in the onshore market.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of exempt status; reassessment of undeclared income at the 27% corporate rate plus a penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded; confiscation of proceeds under the Proceeds of Crime Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal prosecution of directors for aiding tax evasion, with imprisonment up to 5 years and personal civil liability for the full tax debt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing ODC client or payroll payments through the target rails for sanctioned persons, using the low-risk tier to bypass CDD, or failing to file beneficial ownership particulars with the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007: fines up to WST 1,000,000 plus forfeiture of the transaction proceeds; Beneficial Ownership Act 2020: continuing daily default penalties against the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal fines up to WST 500,000, imprisonment up to 3 years, and professional disqualification from acting as company officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Running the ODC entity while insolvent, siphoning development margin to the parent through non-arm's length fees, and defrauding creditors of the Samoan entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal liability under the International Companies Act 1987; the directors become personally and severally liable for all debts of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment up to 3 years, civil restitution of every diverted sum, and a supervisory travel ban pending repayment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the IC Annual Return and to pay the annual government license fee on the anniversary of incorporation, leading to deregistration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary surcharge for late filing; strike-off after prolonged default; any bank balances and intellectual property held by the company escheat to the Government of Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are disqualified from managing any Samoan international company for 5 years and must fund the restoration costs personally before the company can be reinstated.
